Yams 6.2.2

Upstream: https://github.com/jpsim/Yams/releases/tag/6.2.2

Vendored Sources, Package.swift and LICENSE from the release archive, without source changes. LICENSE-libyaml is the upstream LibYAML notice from https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/blob/0.2.5/License. Both notices are also bundled in Muster resources. Keeping the parser in-tree allows offline builds.
